extensions.platform: Native Linux / Qt Quick / Quickshell / Omarchy
extensions.tokenSyntax: DESIGN.md frontmatter owns symbolic native QML binding tokens, not CSS values. Expressions use Panel.qml context; root.systemFontFamily resolves to bar.fontFamily with Style.font.family fallback.

display.purpose: Accent phrase in the summary; horizontally fits long text.

headline.purpose: Noto Kufi Arabic heading or live English system family.

title.purpose: Compact heading for Location, Reminders, Prayer settings and Today.

next-detail.purpose: Prayer name, exact start and explicit tomorrow context.

location.purpose: Recognized preset city/country names follow the language; custom labels remain intact.

date.purpose: Muted Gregorian and Hijri dates under the location.

prayer-name.purpose: Noto Sans Arabic or live English system family; next entry is bold.

prayer-time.purpose: Live system font with layout mirroring disabled; next entry is bold.

body-small.purpose: Location helper text, search feedback and errors.

caption.purpose: Small native form labels and explanations.

native.previewPolicy: Native QML source references replace HTML/CSS approximations. No HTML detector or mobile-platform audit is claimed.
native.layout: Fitted 900-unit preferred overview width, mirrored for Arabic; below 700 fitted logical units, the summary, divider, timetable and action rail stack. Focused views prefer 400 units. Height fits the screen with vertical overflow.
native.motion: Focused views switch immediately. Current Panel.qml defines no custom reveal or settings-opacity animation.
native.elevation: Flat overview with type hierarchy, a foreground hairline and native shell framing; no local shadows, glow or filled timetable rows.

locale.default: Arabic for initial state and missing/invalid saved language; explicit saved English is retained.
locale.summaryCountdown: Model.formatNextCountdown rounds remaining time up to minutes and formats a short phrase in the selected language.
locale.location: Model.localizedLocation translates recognized preset city/country names only when the saved name and coordinates match; custom labels are retained.
locale.barCountdown: Model.formatCountdownShort uses Arabic س/د units and أقل من دقيقة below one minute. Arabic durations and complete labels use balanced Unicode RLI/PDI isolation; English compact formats remain unchanged.
locale.sharedShortDuration: Service.remainingShort passes lang, so tooltip and advance-reminder durations follow the selected language.
locale.clocks: Timetable clock labels use the live system font with LayoutMirroring disabled.

native.scope: Current Arabic and English wide-panel captures were inspected alongside code. Focused-view behavior is documented from code; the separate full-screen adhan overlay is outside these captures.

uiConcept.kind: User-selected generated concept B; illustrative data, not a screenshot

cover.kind: Unchanged selected blue-hour skyline cover; generated promotional artwork with recorded prompt provenance

icon.kind: Authored vector mosque-arch identity and its raster derivative for README branding and proposed marketplace support
icon.marketplaceStatus: Current marketplace hardcodes initials and cannot yet display this icon.

provenance.comparison: Code-led native adaptation and visual inspection; no pixel-exact or measured concept-diff result is claimed.

breakpoints.name: stacked-overview
breakpoints.purpose: Stack below this fitted native panel content width; not a browser or mobile breakpoint.

components.name: Timetable
components.description: Six equal-height rows; next prayer is accent and bold, with unmirrored system-font clocks.

components.name: Action rail
components.description: Settings above language and Today; mirrors with the overview and stacks at limited fitted width.

components.name: Bordered action
components.description: Native focusable icon button for Location, Reminders, Settings or Today; geometry and states belong to qs.Ui.

components.name: Language action
components.description: Quiet overview action naming the destination language and using its matching font.

components.name: Today
components.description: Focused date, Qibla, source, conditional fasting and update-error information with a busy/disabled refresh action.

components.name: Location
components.description: Country filter, offline city presets and city search; extra location controls start collapsed.

components.name: Prayer settings
components.description: Online tables, method suggestion, correction, method, Asr and Hijri controls.

components.name: Reminders
components.description: Delivery mode and at-adhan/advance toggles, with conditional lead-minute stepper.

components.name: Bar widget
components.description: Live-font label with native imminent emphasis; localized Arabic short units and direction isolation in all four styles.

narrative.overview:
The user-selected concept B gives the next prayer a concise summary beside a clear daily timetable. The native surface is calm and direct: a natural-language countdown leads the summary, exact times align in equal rows, and a single divider gives the two reading tasks their own space. Arabic mirrors the composition and is the initial language; an explicit English preference remains available.

The visual system follows live Omarchy colors and English typography, with deliberate Noto Arabic families. This document is extracted from the current QML and JavaScript and checked against the Arabic and English wide-panel captures. The frontmatter preserves native QML bindings as the source of truth; it is not a CSS token export. `root.systemFontFamily` resolves to `bar.fontFamily`, falling back to `Style.font.family`.
keyCharacteristics: Separate next-prayer summary with a natural-language countdown
Six equal timetable rows with accent emphasis on the next prayer
Live desktop colors and English/numeric typography
Noto Arabic families and a mirrored composition
Flat native actions and focused secondary views

rules.name: The Desktop Theme Rule
rules.body: Keep live color bindings. The navy, cream and peach in the captures belong to the active Omarchy theme; they are not fixed interface colors. There is no user-facing appearance switch.

rules.name: The Numeric Rule
rules.body: Timetable clocks keep the live system font and disable layout mirroring. Arabic mirrors the row composition and label alignment while preserving the ordinary reading order of time digits.

dos: Do preserve concept B’s summary, divider, six-row timetable and action rail, mirrored for Arabic and stacked when fitted width is limited.
Do bind interface colors and English/numeric fonts to the live desktop while retaining the Noto Arabic heading/body split.
Do keep Arabic as the default and retain an explicitly saved English choice.
Do keep distinct focused destinations, visible keyboard focus and initially hidden advanced location controls.
Do distinguish the selected generated concept in `artwork/concepts/ui-b-wide.png` from current native captures in `.impeccable/review/wide-ar.png` and `.impeccable/review/wide-en.png`.

Do retain the selected blue-hour cover and its generation provenance. The authored `icon.svg` and raster `icon.png` belong to README branding and proposed marketplace support; their palette does not replace live interface colors.
donts: Don’t add a fixed emerald palette, an appearance selector, oversized countdown numerals or a ring.
Don’t duplicate settings across views or expose all advanced location controls on entry.
Don’t present concept data or the blue-hour cover as a real app screenshot.
Don’t claim the marketplace displays the new icon: it currently renders initials.
Don’t describe this native Linux implementation as a browser or mobile interface, or claim a measured concept-diff result.
